trust_decision.summary: The API starter derives the Slim base path from the raw client-supplied REQUEST_URI (Route::detectBasePath) and, with cache on, Slim persists the base-path-prefixed routes to a shared cache file; nothing decides whether the raw URI is trustworthy enough to seed that shared cache, so one malformed request (leading `//`) fixes a wrong base path for every later request.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'double slash in URI corrupting router cache'; Starter::start is the only place that sets the Slim route cache file and the base path.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP: any request to public/api/v1/index.php (main API) and public/api/v1/portal-access/index.php (portal API; Portal\Api\Starter extends this class)
new static helper Route::isBadUri(), called only from Api\Starter::start (fix.diff:59)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The Portal API (application/Espo/Core/Portal/Api/Starter.php:41-63, own cache file at :52) inherits start() from the base class, so it is covered without a separate change. application/Espo/Core/Application/Runner.php is a docblock-only change (fix.diff:86-96).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Raw-URI variants other than a leading `//` (e.g. `/api//v1/...` or percent-encoded path segments that the web server still routes to index.php) are not in the report's example. A solver could say they are web-server normalisation problems or 'just a 404', not the reported `//` bug.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: detectBasePath legitimately returns '' when the API is served from the root or through a rewrite or custom-URL setup where neither the script name nor its directory prefixes the URI. Rejecting every request that resolves to '', or normalising/rejecting all URIs with repeated slashes deeper in the path (query strings, route params), would break valid installs and requests. The fix must also keep the route cache enabled for normal requests.

O6_input_shapes: REQUEST_URI starting with `//` (str_starts_with check only, fix.diff:123)

O7_producer.where: Slim RouteCollector cache file set at application/Espo/Core/Api/Starter.php:68 (data/cache/application/slim-routes.php, :49; portal variant application/Espo/Core/Portal/Api/Starter.php:52); the base path that gets baked in comes from application/Espo/Core/Api/Starter.php:71

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A raw REQUEST_URI that does not start with `//` but still makes detectBasePath's case-insensitive prefix test fail (inner double slash such as `/api//v1/...`, or a percent-encoded path segment) while the server still dispatches to public/api/v1/index.php. The base path falls back to '' and is written to the shared route cache, which isBadUri does not catch.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The report names only a leading `//`. Whether Apache or nginx forwards these shapes to index.php depends on the server config (public/api/v1/.htaccess:11-12), so a solver can call it a deployment issue.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the new isBadUri helper; one file from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: EntryPoint starter also computes Route::detectBasePath() from the raw URI. A planted route-style cache keyed on that base path here would be a second implementation in another package.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding routing or caching to entry points would copy the API starter pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Portal starter could override start() (e.g. to add portal-specific middleware) and so bypass the base-class isBadUri guard.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Subclasses that override bootstrap methods for portal-specific behaviour are common in this codebase.

O9_family: cache poisoning via request-URI parser differential (CWE-444 label; effect is persistent access denial)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP >=8.2 <8.5 (composer.json:8), Composer with slim/slim ^4.14 and slim/psr7 ^1 (composer.json:22-23); vendor/ is not checked in
services: MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL for a full app boot
web server (Apache/nginx) for realistic REQUEST_URI handling
O10_build.project_tests: No tests for detectBasePath or the API Starter (grep of tests/ finds only REQUEST_URI listed in tests/integration/Core/Utils.php:129). tests/unit/Espo/Core/Utils/RouteTest.php covers route list unification, not base path.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject or strip a leading `//` in REQUEST_URI before Slim starts, leaving other URI shapes that defeat detectBasePath free to seed the shared route cache with a wrong base path.

out_of_scope_notes: application/Espo/Core/Portal/Utils/Url.php:42-51 picks the portal ID by splitting raw REQUEST_URI on '/', so a leading `//` shifts the index; the portal ID flows into the per-portal cache file name (application/Espo/Core/Portal/Api/Starter.php:52). Not pursued.
install/entry.php:134 and install/core/SystemHelper.php:89-91 build URLs from HTTP_HOST/REQUEST_URI (installer, separate concern).
